prompt.zh-TW: 步驟②（勾稽點 A）要比對的是哪兩個數字？
prompt.en: Which two figures does step 2 (check A) compare?

text.zh-TW: 損益表的稅前淨利，與現金流量表起算的稅前淨利
text.en: Profit before tax on the income statement, and the profit before tax that the statement of cash flows starts from

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。間接法的現金流量表是從稅前淨利開始往下算的，第一列這個數字必須和損益表上的一模一樣。
feedback.en: Correct. The indirect-method statement of cash flows works downwards from profit before tax, and that first-line figure must be identical to the one on the income statement.

text.zh-TW: 損益表的本期淨利，與現金流量表起算的本期淨利
text.en: Profit for the period on the income statement, and the profit for the period that the statement of cash flows starts from

feedback.zh-TW: 你找對了兩張表，只是層數不對。本課現金流量表的第一列標的就是稅前淨利，所以要抄同一層，不是本期淨利。
feedback.en: You picked the right two statements, but the wrong level. In this course the first line of the statement of cash flows is labelled profit before tax, so the same level has to be carried across, not profit for the period.

text.zh-TW: 損益表的營業利益，與資產負債表裡的未分配盈餘
text.en: Operating profit on the income statement, and unappropriated retained earnings on the balance sheet

feedback.zh-TW: 這兩個數字之間沒有勾稽關係。和未分配盈餘對應的是本期淨利（步驟④），而且比的是增加額，不是營業利益。
feedback.en: There is no check between these two figures. What ties to unappropriated retained earnings is profit for the period (step 4), and it is the increase that is compared, not operating profit.

explanation.zh-TW: 步驟②把損益表與現金流量表接起來：{{option:o_btv9}}。間接法的第一列就是把稅前淨利抄過來，所以兩邊一定要相等；如果不等，通常是現金流量表的起點抄錯了層。
explanation.en: Step 2 joins the income statement to the statement of cash flows: {{option:o_btv9}}. The first line of the indirect method simply carries profit before tax across, so the two must be equal; if they are not, the starting point of the statement of cash flows was usually copied from the wrong level.
